CORPORATION.definition_en: A legally or commercially organized company or business entity.
CORPORATION.definition_ar: شركة أو كيان تجاري منظم قانونياً أو تجارياً.
CORPORATION.boundaries: Includes commercial organizations; excludes a bank when bank identity is the semantic role and excludes public authorities.

BANK.definition_en: A bank or financial institution as an organization, not an account identifier.
BANK.definition_ar: بنك أو مؤسسة مالية بصفتها جهة، وليس رقم حساب مصرفي.
BANK.boundaries: Does not include account numbers, balances, or every institution merely because a banking task is discussed.

GOVERNMENT_ENTITY.definition_en: A ministry, regulator, public authority, or government agency.
GOVERNMENT_ENTITY.definition_ar: وزارة أو جهة رقابية أو هيئة عامة أو وكالة حكومية.
GOVERNMENT_ENTITY.boundaries: Excludes private companies and banks unless the institution is explicitly acting as a public authority.
relevance_examples: route a complaint to an authority

DATE.definition_en: A calendar date, deadline, period boundary, or event time.
DATE.definition_ar: تاريخ تقويمي أو موعد نهائي أو حد زمني أو وقت حدث.
DATE.boundaries: A birth date is a DATE occurrence; age is a derived demographic quantity. Application date and birth date have different roles.

OCCUPATION.definition_en: A broad profession, trade, or field of work.
OCCUPATION.definition_ar: مهنة أو حرفة أو مجال عمل عام.
OCCUPATION.boundaries: Broad profession such as accounting or medicine; not a specific rank or position such as senior auditor.

JOB_TITLE.definition_en: A specific organizational position, function, or rank held by a person.
JOB_TITLE.definition_ar: منصب أو وظيفة أو درجة تنظيمية محددة يشغلها الشخص.
JOB_TITLE.boundaries: Specific title such as senior auditor; not the broader profession of accounting.

NATIONALITY.definition_en: A person's nationality or citizenship affiliation.
NATIONALITY.definition_ar: جنسية الشخص أو انتماؤه القانوني كمواطن.
NATIONALITY.boundaries: Nationality/citizenship is not country of residence, birth, employer, bank, or transaction destination.

AGE.definition_en: A person's age, age band, or age-related eligibility fact.
AGE.definition_ar: عمر الشخص أو فئته العمرية أو حقيقة أهلية مرتبطة بالعمر.
AGE.boundaries: Age is not a calendar date; a date of birth can support age calculation but remains a DATE occurrence.

MONETARY_AMOUNT.definition_en: A quantity of money, independent of its business role or currency unit.
MONETARY_AMOUNT.definition_ar: كمية من المال بصرف النظر عن دورها التجاري أو وحدة العملة.
MONETARY_AMOUNT.boundaries: The type covers many semantic roles. Requiring salary can make the type relevant without making every monetary occurrence relevant; currency alone is not an amount.

COUNTRY.definition_en: A country or jurisdiction in a role stated by the task.
COUNTRY.definition_ar: دولة أو نطاق قضائي وفق الدور المحدد في المهمة.
COUNTRY.boundaries: Country role matters: residence, citizenship, birth, bank location, employer location, and incorporation are not interchangeable. Prompt-only type classification cannot identify which document occurrences share the requested role.
